guarantees.claim: unused_key_dec is the combinational XOR of key_dec_sel, key_dec_we, and the bitwise reduction XOR of each element of key_dec_d across all NumShares.

uncertain_points.claim: Signal unused_key_dec appears to be a dummy combinational output whose sole purpose is to reference key_dec_sel, key_dec_we, and key_dec_d to avoid lint/synthesis unused-warning removal. It is unclear whether any downstream logic reads this signal or if it is intended purely as a dummy.
uncertain_points.risk: If the signal is truly unused, no functional impact. If some logic unexpectedly depends on its value (parity over control inputs), a mismatch in synthesis or optimization could silently alter behavior.
